parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin protective coating. It is a flat rectangular component that forms the front face of the display.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from the computer or connected device, including images, videos, and text. It is the main interface for visual interaction.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt slightly depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum. It provides structural support and stability to the screen.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the display, keeping it upright and stable on a desk or surface. It may also contain a hinge mechanism for adjusting the screen angle.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow limited tilting or rotation of the screen through an integrated hinge.
